messages.content: Hello! I am your Product Manager for BioVault Lab Specimen Tracker. I have reviewed the discovery log from our Business Analyst. We are solving the core pain: Yes, please proceed with the discovery questions.... I have prepared the complete, grounded Product Requirement Document (PRD) adhering strictly to the handbook standard. You can review the full PRD and the stage-by-stage token and cost estimates below.

scores.evidence: Found 9 unique features. Must-have FR coverage: 8/8.
Found 18 unique ACs with 27 Given/When/Then clauses across 9 features. Vague terms present: False.
Detected 9 explicit (unhappy path) criteria across 9 features.
Non-goals table (NG-###) present with rationale and source citations.
Success metrics with numeric targets and telemetry/query measurement methods present.
Clean separation of FRs and NFRs.
All roles, claims, and numbers strictly grounded in discovery answers.
